intro.title: COMMAND YOUR CLUB
intro.subtitle: The all-in-one B2B management engine for Wargaming, RPGs, and Trading Card Games. Built for tournament organizers, tabletop clubs, and local game stores.

general.title: UNIFIED COMMAND INFRASTRUCTURE
general.description: Everything your club or store needs to automate daily operations, connect players, and run events across any game system.

subScheduling.title: SCHEDULING HELPER & ATTENDANCE
subScheduling.description: Smart date-polling, automated table reservations, capacity limits, and one-click RSVP tracking so you always know which tables are active.

subDiscord.title: NATIVE DISCORD BOT & INTEGRATIONS
subDiscord.description: Two-way Discord sync: automated round pairings, event reminders, role assignments, and result reporting directly inside your club server.

subMatchmaking.title: MULTI-SYSTEM ELO & HYBRID TOURNAMENTS
subMatchmaking.description: Dedicated ELO ratings per game system alongside instant matchmaking and tournament setup—supporting local, online, live, and asynchronous play.

tabletop.title: MULTI-SYSTEM TABLETOP COMMAND
tabletop.description: Built for Games Workshop systems, historicals, and indie skirmishers alike. Manage competitive GTs and sprawling narrative campaigns in one hub.

subSystems.title: MULTI-SYSTEM SUPPORT (GW & BEYOND)
subSystems.description: Tailored scoring matrices, differential points, and table layouts for major grimdark, fantasy, and skirmish rulesets.

subCampaign.title: NARRATIVE CAMPAIGN EDITOR
subCampaign.description: Visual campaign builder for planetary crusades, territory control, persistent unit XP, battle scars, and custom mission trees.

subListViewer.title: INTEGRATED ARMY LIST VIEWER
subListViewer.description: Instant roster imports, clean stat-profile formatting, list-lock validation, and one-tap opponent list inspection at the table.

rpg.title: LIVING CAMPAIGN CHRONICLES
rpg.description: Empower Game Masters to run persistent shared worlds, open-table West Marches, and long-running club chronicles without administrative burnout.

subSheets.title: DIGITAL CHARACTER SHEETS
subSheets.description: System-agnostic, live-synced character sheets with inventory management, leveling logs, and GM-verified stat blocks.

subWorldMap.title: INTERACTIVE WORLD & HEX-MAP ENGINE
subWorldMap.description: Shared campaign maps with dynamic fog-of-war, discovered location pins, faction influence zones, and travel route calculators.

subSession.title: PARTY LOOT, BASTIONS & SESSION LOGS
subSession.description: Shared party treasuries, downtime bastion progression, NPC codexes, and automated quest briefings pushed straight to Discord.

tcg.title: HIGH-SPEED TCG ARENA
tcg.description: Run 60-player Friday night pods, weekend qualifiers, and seasonal store leagues with zero bottleneck at the judge counter.

subDeckViewer.title: VISUAL DECKVIEWER & LEGALITY CHECK
subDeckViewer.description: Interactive decklist inspection, mana-curve breakdowns, format ban-list validation, and sideboard verification before round one.

subIngame.title: LIVE IN-GAME COMPANION APP
subIngame.description: Synchronized mobile life-point counters, poison/commander damage trackers, round timers, and instant two-player match result sign-off.

subDraft.title: DRAFT PODS, CUBE & PRIZE LEDGER
subDraft.description: Automated pod seating, cross-pod pairing protection, cube card-pool tracking, and store-credit prize distribution logs.
